title: Meta Advertising Standards, Special Ad Categories & Account Health
overview: Meta Advertising Standards outline allowed, restricted, and prohibited ad content on Facebook, Instagram, and Messenger to maintain community safety and regulatory compliance.
coreConcepts: Special Ad Categories (Housing, Employment, Credit, Social Issues) restricting targeting
Personal Attributes policy: ads must not imply or state personal characteristics (race, religion, health, financial status)
Non-functional landing page penalties (broken links, excessive popups, deceptive redirects)
Customer Feedback Score (0 to 5) monitoring post-purchase customer satisfaction
features: Account Quality dashboard showing ad rejections, policy strikes, and feedback scores
Request Review tool for manual appeal of automated rejection decisions
Ad Library providing public transparency for all active commercial advertisements
Business Asset Groups managing multi-client permission scoping safely
bestPractices: Never use copy asking 'Do you have diabetes?' or 'Are you in debt?' (direct personal attribute violations)
Ensure landing page displays transparent shipping times, clear returns, and contact details
If advertising housing, loans, or employment, declare the Special Ad Category upfront
Maintain customer feedback score > 3.0 to avoid delivery penalty CPM surcharges
policies: Prohibited: Adult content, discriminatory practices, deceptive claims, predatory financial products
Restricted: Alcohol, dating services, cosmetic procedures, subscription services
Special Ad Categories: No age, gender, zip code, or demographic targeting exclusions allowed
limitations: Appeals can take up to 48 hours for human review resolution
Repeated policy strikes result in ad account disablement or Business Manager restrictions
Advertisers cannot target specific postal codes within Housing or Employment categories
commonIssues: Ad rejection for 'Personal Attributes' when describing customer pain points too directly
Ad account disabled due to low Customer Feedback Score (< 1.5)
Disapproval for 'Sensational content' when using close-up bodily images or dramatic before/after photos

troubleshootingGuide.resolution: Reframe copy from second-person ('Are you struggling with X?') to first-person or third-person storytelling ('How our customers overcome X')
Audit supply chain fulfillment speeds and update shipping estimates in post-purchase confirmation emails
